Jagiellonia draw at Sunderland in the Europa League after Reinildo error

Adrian Siemieniec · Sport

Jagiellonia Bialystok drew at Sunderland in the Europa League after an error by Reinildo. They responded to falling behind with an almost immediate equalizer and defended well against Sunderland's struggles in front of goal. Head coach Adrian Siemieniec called the trip one of the biggest highlights of his career.

Reported by The Guardian. Written by AI.
